scope_note: This reports Freud's 1904 attribution of the cathartic therapy to Breuer; it does not attribute Freud's later psychoanalytic system wholesale to Breuer.
statement: Freud's 1904 account credited the discovery of cathartic therapy to Josef Breuer and described psychoanalysis as an outgrowth of that method.
statement_zh: Freud 在 1904 年的說明中，把宣洩療法的發現歸功於 Josef Breuer，並把精神分析描述為由該方法發展而來。
